text.title: Accessibility-First Design Failure Modes
text.summary: 6 antipatterns observed when applying accessibility-first-design; each pairs symptom + root cause + concrete fix.

antipattern.symptom: Brand-mandated colour pair ships with 3.1:1 contrast on body text; AA failure at launch.
antipattern.root-cause: Brand reviewed colour aesthetically; contrast check ran post-implementation.
antipattern.fix: Token gate at design stage: pairs failing thresholds excluded from system; brand exceptions require a documented override + decorative-only role.

antipattern.symptom: Global `*:focus { outline: none }` strips focus indicator across the app.
antipattern.fix: Token-level :focus-visible mandatory on every interactive archetype; CSS lint forbids global outline:none.

antipattern.symptom: Parallax + auto-scroll animations play for users with vestibular disorders.
antipattern.fix: Every motion token carries a reduced-motion variant; CI lint flags raw transitions without a media-query partner.

antipattern.symptom: LLMs hallucinating WCAG criterion numbers (e.g., citing "WCAG 1.4.13" for an issue that is actually 1.4.11).
antipattern.root-cause: Agents are prone to criterion number errors. Constrain to a pre-validated rule list and require the agent to cite the exact SC number and name. Reviewers will catch and reject incorrect citations.
antipattern.fix: Give the agent a closed SC list (number + name) and reject any finding whose citation is not on it.

antipattern.symptom: Estimating contrast ratios from screenshots rather than extracting hex values from tokens or the DOM.
antipattern.root-cause: Screenshot-based contrast estimation is unreliable due to JPEG compression, rendering engine differences, and anti-aliasing. Always extract actual color values programmatically.
antipattern.fix: Compute contrast from token or DOM hex values (templates/a11y_quick.ts); treat any screenshot-derived ratio as unverified.

antipattern.symptom: Generating false positives for "color not the only indicator" on icons that already have adjacent labels.
antipattern.root-cause: Agents apply this rule mechanically without understanding that a color-coded icon with a text label already satisfies SC 1.4.1. Provide context including adjacent element content.
antipattern.fix: Feed the agent the adjacent element content with each color signal so labelled icons are recognised as compliant.
